info.title: Geoapify Map Marker API
info.description: Generate customizable PNG map marker images with a background shape, icon or text content, colors, and resolution scaling.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

get.description:
Generates a customizable PNG marker.

- Background: `type`
- Content: `icon` + `iconType`, or `text`
- Sizing: `contentSize` and `size`

**Example:** `type=material`, `iconType=material`, `icon=favorite`, `contentSize=20`, `color=#ff5050`, `noWhiteCircle=true`, `noShadow=true`

**Icons:** [Material Icons](https://fonts.google.com/icons) · [Font Awesome 6 Free](https://fontawesome.com/v6/search?m=free&o=r) · [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/icons/)

**Docs:** [Marker Icon API documentation](https://apidocs.geoapify.com/docs/icon/)

> Follow the selected icon library's license and attribution requirements.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Marker background shape. `material` uses a Material-style pin, `awesome` uses a Font Awesome-style pin, `circle` uses a circular background, and `plain` renders only the icon or text without a background shape.

parameters.name: iconType
parameters.description:
Icon library used to resolve the `icon` name. When omitted, the default depends on the marker `type`: `material` for material and circle markers, and `awesome` for awesome markers.

**Icons:** [Material Icons](https://fonts.google.com/icons) · [Font Awesome 6 Free](https://fontawesome.com/v6/search?m=free&o=r) · [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/icons/)

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description:
Icon name from the library selected by `iconType`. When `text` is also provided, text is rendered instead of the icon.

**Icons:** [Material Icons](https://fonts.google.com/icons) · [Font Awesome 6 Free](https://fontawesome.com/v6/search?m=free&o=r) · [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/icons/)

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text rendered inside the marker instead of an icon. When both `text` and `icon` are provided, `text` takes precedence.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Intended marker image height in CSS pixels. Use `scaleFactor` to increase output resolution without changing the intended display size.

parameters.name: contentSize
parameters.description: Height of the icon or text content in CSS pixels. When omitted, the API chooses a size proportional to the marker size.

parameters.name: scaleFactor
parameters.description: Output pixel-density multiplier from 0.5 to 10. For example, use `2` for a double-resolution image and display it at its logical `size` for sharper rendering.

parameters.name: strokeColor
parameters.description: Marker background-shape outline color. Ignored when `type=plain`.

parameters.name: contentColor
parameters.description: Color of the icon or text rendered inside the marker.

parameters.name: noWhiteCircle
parameters.description: Set to `true` to remove the white circle behind marker content.

parameters.name: noShadow
parameters.description: Set to `true` to remove the marker shadow.

200.description: Binary PNG marker image ready for use in HTML, CSS, or a client-side map library.

example.message: size should be a positive number

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

ColorValue.description: CSS-like color value. Hex, named colors, `rgb()`, and `rgba()` are accepted. HTTP clients must URL-encode reserved characters such as `#`; OpenAPI clients such as Swagger UI do this automatically.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the gateway.

ApiKeyInQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyInQuery.description: Geoapify API key query parameter. Recommended authentication method for public APIs. API keys in URLs can be logged; use x-api-key for server-to-server clients.

ApiKeyInHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyInHeader.description: Geoapify API key header. Supported as an alternative authentication method for public APIs.
